name: 露梅雅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:214
who: Lumeya, a dark elf of the Verdant Court, the youngest attendant in Aethelia's retinue: a hundred and twenty years old but, as a slow-ageing elf, looking about sixteen or seventeen. About 168 cm, tall for her age, slender and long-limbed, fully covered by her clothes. Skin pale grey-white with a faint ash undertone, like stone that never saw the sun. Black hair with a deep moss-green sheen, in one thick braid hanging down her back. Long pointed ears; on the tip of the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) hangs a small ring bent from a sliver of root-wood. Silver-grey eyes that do not catch light in the dark and look first at what a person holds in their hands. Two clay water jars hang from a strap over her shoulder. A quiet, watchful, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young dark-elf face of about sixteen: medium-large almond eyes of silver-grey, level dark lashes, thin straight brows; a small straight nose; a closed, quiet mouth; skin pale grey-white with cool grey shadows.
palette: moss grey-green, ash grey-white, root brown, dark green-black hair, unglazed clay
casual: Her working dress as a court attendant: a long moss-grey-green dress with long sleeves and a high plain collar, the hem hitched up and tucked into the belt over grey leggings and soft leather boots; across her chest a leather strap carrying two small unglazed clay jars, one full of water and one empty, to catch newly found water; a small herb pouch and a tiny root-whittling knife at the belt; the black-green braid down her back, the root-wood ring in her left ear. She stands upright and attentive, hands on the jar strap.
private: Off duty in a root-hall: the dress hem let down, the jars set on the floor, a soft long-sleeved undyed wool tunic-dress to the shins in pale grey-green, grey woollen stockings and house shoes, the braid over one shoulder. She holds a small seedling in a cup of damp earth, a calm, attentive look.
battle: Ready to cross open ground: the grey-green dress hitched up and belted over fitted dark leggings, a short leather jerkin and forearm guards, the two jars tied snug at her back so they cannot swing, the herb pouch at her belt. In her right hand a small bent root-wood knife held low, her left hand open and ready; a steady, serious look.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit in the field: crouched low with one knee on the ground and one palm pressed flat to the earth, the other hand holding the full water jar steady, the eyes wide open and alert, the mouth closed, no weapon drawn.
formal: Before the Verdant Court's elders: a knee-length deep grey-green wool surcoat over a pale undershirt and dark leggings, long sleeves, a narrow band of root-and-leaf embroidery in silver-green thread at hem and cuffs, three small sewn rings in grey-blue on the left breast as the corps mark, a plain grey half-cape pinned with a small silver pin, the braid tied up with a green cord, the root-wood ring in her ear, a sprig of living moss on the pin that stays green. She stands very straight with the hands folded before her, a composed, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the silver-grey eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer, a serious, quiet look, the mouth closed. Cool green-grey light comes from one side, as if from a root hollow, and a single droplet of water hangs on the lip of the clay jar she cradles near her chest. Foreground blur: pale roots and a few drifting spores of light.

name: 弗兰茨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:270
who: Franz, a human dispatch runner of the southern wall, nineteen: about 181 cm, very tall and thin, long-limbed, a grown young man with a gangly runner's build. Short flax-coloured hair, hazel eyes that watch a speaker's mouth closely so as not to miss a word. His lips are chapped and cracked from shouting. A leather letter satchel on a strap across his chest. A strip of red cloth sewn on one shoulder. A diffident, earnest, quick air; a voice far bigger than his body.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young man's face of nineteen with a sharp jaw, hazel eyes that look earnest and wide, short pale-flax brows, chapped lips, a little windburn on the cheeks.
palette: flax and hazel, wall-stone grey, leather brown, a strip of signal red
casual: His dispatch runner's uniform: a short leather jacket with a strip of red cloth sewn across one shoulder so that people on the wall give way from far off; an oilskin letter satchel on a strap across the chest with a small brass tag on its flap; plain trousers and soft-soled boots worn thin with iron cleats nailed to the soles. At the belt a short sword in its sheath that has never been drawn. He stands tall, leaning slightly forward, mouth set, ready to run.
private: Between runs in a wall-town barracks: the jacket off, a plain long-sleeved linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, brown trousers and soft slippers, the satchel hung on a peg and the red cloth strip folded in his hand. He sips water from a tin cup, a tired, earnest look.
battle: At the wall in an alarm: the red-shouldered leather jacket buckled tight, the satchel slung to his back, leather bracers, cleated boots planted on the stones. In his right hand the short sword drawn at last and held low and unsteadily, his left hand raised flat as a signal; a tense, wide-eyed look.
battle_pose: 3) the dispatch outfit in the alarm: mid-stride in a full sprint along the wall-walk, the body leaning hard forward, one arm pumping and the other clutching the satchel strap, the red shoulder strip streaming, the mouth open in a shout.
formal: For reading a long message aloud before the garrison: the dispatch runner's short leather jacket cleaned and oiled, the red cloth strip on the shoulder pressed flat, a brass courier tag on the chest, a fresh white shirt collar open at the neck, clean trousers bound at the ankle, polished cleated boots, the oilskin satchel held in front with both hands, its brass tag shining with a faint spell-mark. He stands straight, chin up, a nervous but proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the hazel eyes looking straight at the viewer with an earnest, wide-eyed look, the cracked lips pressed together in a nervous half-smile. Cold white wall-light from one side, the red cloth strip bright at his shoulder. Foreground blur: a wind-blown strip of red cloth and a flying sheet of folded message paper.

name: 乌苏
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:326
who: Ursu, a beast-eared scout of the Bell-tail clan of the southern wall, ninety years old but a slow-ageing hero looking about forty-five: about 183 cm, tall, lean and long-armed. Short sandy hair with grey coming in at the temples; a pair of sandy upright cat-like ears, the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) missing a small notch at its tip, bitten by an iron wolf. A long tail with a small brass bell tied at the tip that rings at every step. Amber eyes that look at the shadow under a person's feet before the face. Palms hardened with rope calluses and criss-crossed with rope-burn lines. A quiet, careful, patient air. His eyes are warm amber, a clear orange-gold like resin, plainly lighter and warmer than his sandy hair, the same colour in every panel. The tip of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a small V-shaped bite missing, clearly drawn in every panel; the right ear is whole.
build: 183 cm, tall, lean and long-armed: narrow hips, wiry shoulders and forearms strong from holding rope, a straight-backed careful stance.
palette: sand and amber, ash-grey leather, bell brass, rope hemp, a little grey at the temples
casual: A Bell-tail scout's grey leather short jerkin with sleeves bound at the cuffs and a ring of rope loops at the belt; a rope slung diagonally from the back across the chest and coiled in a figure-eight; dark trousers bound at the ankle, soft short boots with a thin copper sole. A short knife in a sheath with a strip of dried meat tied to it. On his back a long thick rope hung with many small bells, tightly coiled, the knot at its end never untied. The brass bell tied at the tip of his tail. He stands low and relaxed, one hand resting on the coil.
private: At rest in a wall-town stable loft: the jerkin off, a loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, plain trousers and bare feet, the tail bell wrapped in cloth so it will not ring, the long rope coiled beside him. He rubs a rope blister on his palm, a patient, tired look.
battle: Ready to scout the dead land: the grey leather jerkin buckled, a dark cloak-blanket wrapped over one shoulder, the rope coil across his chest, forearm guards bound on. In his right hand a short knife held low, in his left the end of the long belled rope paid out behind him; crouched, ears forward, amber eyes narrowed.
formal: At the standing of the seven stones: the Bell-tail scout's grey leather short jerkin brushed clean with the sleeves still bound at the cuffs, a dark blue sash, a freshly washed scouts' blanket folded over one shoulder, trouser legs bound, copper-soled boots polished, the long belled rope coiled neatly over the other shoulder, the tail bell polished and humming faintly. He stands very straight with his hands folded behind his back, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned a little, the amber eyes looking down past the viewer as if at their shadow, a quiet, steady look. Cold dusky light from one side. He holds a few small brass bells in one calloused hand near his chest. Foreground blur: rope fibres and drifting grey ash.

name: 伊萝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:470
who: Iro, a wood elf of the Watcher clan, youngest of seven archer sisters, a hundred and one years old but as a slow-ageing elf looking about sixteen. About 160 cm, the smallest of her sisters, slender and light, fully covered by her clothes. Long honey-gold hair in one braid down to the lower back, a fresh pale-green cloth strip tied at its end. Pointed ears. Moss-green eyes with big pupils that glow faintly in the dark like still water under a forest canopy. Two white callus bands on the pads of the left index and middle fingers. A tall longbow taller than herself on her back. A curious, chattering, restless air. The longbow is plain pale wood with no writing, runes or symbols on it; there is no carving, emblem, rune, glyph or lettering of any kind anywhere on it, in any panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young elf face of about sixteen: medium-large moss-green almond eyes with large pupils, soft honey-gold brows, a small straight nose, a bright eager closed-mouth smile; light skin with a warm cheek flush.
palette: honey gold, moss green, grey-green cloak, bow wood brown, pale spring green
casual: A Watcher's new grey-green hooded cloak, issued this spring and not yet faded, over a plain forest-green tunic belted at the waist, long sleeves, brown leggings and soft leather boots. A longbow taller than her on her back its wood plain and unmarked, a quiver of arrows at her side, a small whittling knife; at her belt hangs a thumb-sized wooden bell that cannot ring, the first she ruined whittling. The honey braid with a pale green cloth strip. She stands on tiptoe, head tilted, bright-eyed and eager.
private: In the wall-tower after the watch: the cloak off, a soft long-sleeved green wool tunic-dress to the shins, woollen stockings and house shoes, the braid over one shoulder. She sits cross-legged whittling a small wooden bell and chatting, a cheerful, wide-eyed look.
battle: On the stone ridge of the deer-spring pass: the grey-green cloak pinned back with a leaf pin, a short leather jerkin and forearm guards with a sewn leaf-and-bow badge on the shoulder, quiver full at her side with a few arrows whose heads glimmer faintly. She draws the tall longbow to full length, the string at her cheek, the arrow aimed straight ahead, left hand steady on the bow, eyes wide open and fixed; a fierce, concentrated look with the mouth closed.
formal: For the Watcher clan's gathering: a short forest-green wool jerkin over a pale tunic and brown leggings, sleeves bound at the cuffs with silver-green cord, a sewn badge of a leaf and bow on the left shoulder, the new grey-green cloak held with a leaf-shaped pin whose small stone glints faintly, the braid freshly done with a new pale green ribbon, clean soft boots. She stands straight with hands folded, a proud, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the moss-green eyes wide open with large dark pupils glowing softly, looking straight at the viewer with a bright, eager look, a small closed-mouth grin. She holds a small wooden bell near her chin. Cool green twilight from one side. Foreground blur: out-of-focus arrow fletchings and drifting leaves.

name: 琳内特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:526
who: Linnet of the Birke family, a human bell-ringer of the forest clearings, eighteen: about 158 cm, short, sturdy and strong-armed, a young woman with a broad-palmed right hand stronger than the left. Fluffy ginger hair in a low ponytail that swings behind her when she runs. Clear blue eyes and a light scatter of freckles across both cheeks, the most freckled in the clearing. A cord of hemp round her left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us) threaded with nine wooden beads, one bead for each bell. A willow basket on her back. A bright, lively, outdoor air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, young woman's face of eighteen with clear blue eyes, a light scatter of freckles across both cheeks and nose, a straight small nose, a wide cheerful mouth.
build: 158 cm, short and sturdy: strong shoulders and arms, a soft rounded figure, a C-cup, a firm waist.
palette: ginger orange, sky blue, linen cream, moss green, willow brown
casual: A clearing family's short linen jacket with fraying cuffs over a plain dress whose hem is tucked up into the belt for walking, over brown leggings and worn boots. On her back a willow basket lined with dry moss in which nine small bells lie side by side so they will not knock; at the belt a cloth bag holding her family's leaf-tally notebook and a few styptic herbs. The hemp cord with nine wooden beads on her left wrist. The ginger ponytail swinging. She stands sturdy and cheerful, one hand on the basket strap.
private: At home in the clearing house: the jacket off, a soft long-sleeved undyed linen dress to the shins with a plain apron, woollen stockings and house shoes, the ponytail loosened over one shoulder. She holds a small bell up to her ear and listens to it, a happy, sleepy smile.
battle: Out on the road in danger: the linen jacket buckled up, a short leather vest and forearm guards, the willow basket carried in front in both arms to guard the bells, the herb bag at the belt. In her right hand a short walking staff with a bell tied to its head, held crosswise; a determined look, the brows drawn together.
battle_pose: 3) the clearing outfit in danger: braced low with her feet planted wide and the basket clutched protectively to her chest with the left arm while the right hand swings a hand-bell at full length, the ginger ponytail whipping, a fierce, determined look.
formal: For a clearing's festival: a long cornflower-blue linen dress with long sleeves, a clean white apron with embroidered green leaves at its hem, a woven leaf crown over the ginger hair, the nine-bead cord on her wrist, a small bell tied at her waist. She stands straight with hands folded in front, a bright, warm smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with an open, warm look, a wide cheerful smile. She holds one small bronze bell beside her cheek. Warm morning sun from one side. Foreground blur: out-of-focus green leaves and a drifting ginger strand.

name: 胡格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:582
who: Hug, a half-orc stretcher-bearer of the White Candle's field hospital behind the southern wall, thirty-seven: about 214 cm, so tall he ducks through doors, very broad in the shoulder, the back bowed slightly forward from years under stretchers. Grey-blue skin. Iron-rust red hair shaved down to a single strip on top and braided into a short plait. Two lower tusks each ringed with a copper band, put on at coming of age in the grey ditches. Yellow-green eyes that look first at where someone is bleeding. Huge hands, one of which can hold a man's whole back. A slow, gentle, steady air.
build: 214 cm, huge and heavy: very broad shoulders, long thick arms, a slightly bowed back, a barrel chest and powerful legs.
palette: grey-blue skin, rust red, washed grey-white, ash-wood pale yellow, copper
casual: A white-candle stretcher-bearer's rough cloth smock, once white and washed to grey-white, over plain brown trousers; strapped on his back three folded stretchers with ash-wood poles worn smooth and bright; thick leather boots with the soles worn thin; a water flask, a roll of bandage strips and a pair of bandage shears at the belt; the red braid on top of his shaved head and the copper rings on his tusks. He stands calm and hunched slightly, one great hand open.
private: Off duty beside the field hospital tents: the smock off, a loose long-sleeved coarse linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, brown trousers, the boots hung around his neck and bare feet. He sits on an upturned bucket with a tin bowl of broth, a gentle, tired look.
battle: Carrying the wounded under threat: the grey-white smock belted tight, a heavy leather apron over it and leather forearm guards, three folded stretchers on his back. One huge arm holds a limp wounded soldier across his shoulders, the other hand grips the iron-shod end of a stretcher pole like a staff; braced forward, a grim steady look.
battle_pose: 3) the stretcher-bearer outfit under threat: a wide braced stance, a wounded soldier carried across both shoulders, the stretcher poles held crosswise in front like a barrier, tusks bared and brows lowered, a protective, grim look.
formal: For a funeral muster on the wall: the white-candle stretcher-bearer's smock washed and pressed, grey-white, with a clean leather apron over it, a white candle sash across one shoulder, forearm wraps freshly bound, the red braid retied, the copper tusk rings polished, one folded stretcher held upright beside him like a banner staff, a small wax-sealed charm tied to its pole that gives off a steady pale glow. He stands very straight, head slightly bowed, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the head ducked a little to fit the frame, the yellow-green eyes looking gently and steadily at the viewer, a calm look with the mouth closed over the tusks. Warm candle light from one side. His huge open hand is held up beside his cheek. Foreground blur: out-of-focus white bandage strips and drifting ash.

name: 沃普克·埃布
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:727
who: Wupke Ebb, a human squad leader of the first sky-tall war construct, a former salt-sea fleet captain, seventy-two and looking it: about 175 cm, medium height, shoulders broad, the back slightly stooped, standing with the legs wide as if on a rolling deck. Short white hair, a neatly trimmed white beard, an old scar across his right cheekbone (on the viewer's left when they face us) from a snapped iron chain. Sea-blue eyes the colour of salt water that look first at the shadow behind a person. Cheeks permanently reddened by salt wind, cracked, dry hands. A calm, steady, dryly humorous air.
build: 175 cm, medium height with broad shoulders and a slight stoop, a sturdy old sailor's frame, still upright and strong in the legs.
palette: white and salt grey, sea blue, brass, oilcloth navy, weathered red cheeks
casual: An old fleet captain's navy wool coat, the elbows patched twice and the brass buttons rubbed bright, over a plain grey shirt and dark trousers with sea boots. At the belt a notebook wrapped in oilcloth with a stub of charcoal tied to it on a string. On his right wrist (on the viewer's left when they face us) a cord tied with many knots, one for each thing remembered. Round his neck a small brass whistle on a cord, unused here. He stands with his legs set wide, hands behind his back.
private: In the construct's mess after the watch: the coat off and hung on a hook, a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt and waistcoat, slippers, the notebook open before him on a tin table. He rubs his cracked hands in the lamp light, a mild, thoughtful look.
battle: Commanding in the head chamber: the patched navy coat buttoned up, a leather harness belt and brass whistle round his neck, a bell cord in his right hand to ring instead of shouting, the left hand on the rail. Legs wide and braced, eyes narrowed and fixed ahead; a steady, commanding look.
battle_pose: 3) the fleet captain's outfit at the helm: standing braced with feet wide apart, one hand gripping an overhead bell rope and pulling, the other hand pointing forward, the white beard and coat tails swinging with the sway, a stern, focused look.
formal: For the unveiling of a new war construct: his best deep navy fleet coat, buttons all present and polished, a white shirt with a plain black neckcloth, polished sea boots, the knotted cord on his wrist, a captain's brass pin on the collar. He stands very upright, hands behind his back, a dignified, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the sea-blue eyes looking past the viewer's shoulder as if at the shadow behind them, a calm, weathered look. Cool blue-white light from one side, as of a salt-sea window. His cracked hand holds the knotted cord up near his chest. Foreground blur: out-of-focus brass rails and drifting salt crystals.

name: 梅特·施蒂勒
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:783
who: Mette Stiller, a human spell-corps caster in the outer ring of the first sky-tall war construct, eighteen: about 163 cm, medium height, sturdy with broad shoulders from hauling bell ropes as a child. Copper-coloured hair cut to just below the ears, like a freshly cast bell. Verdigris blue-green eyes like rust on bronze. Thin knife-cut scars across the right index finger (on the viewer's left when they face us) from carving names. A small bronze pendant on a leather cord round her neck. A restless, talkative, bright air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of eighteen: verdigris blue-green almond eyes, short level copper brows, a straight nose, a quick mouth that is usually in the middle of speaking; clear light skin.
build: 163 cm, sturdy: broad shoulders and strong arms, a C-cup, a firm waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: copper and verdigris, spell-corps grey-blue, bell bronze, rope hemp
casual: A spell-corps grey-blue short robe with tight cuffs, three embroidered rings on the left breast marking the outer ring, closing down the front with buttons, over a plain shirt, dark trousers and boots. At the belt a small carving knife with a hemp-wrapped handle. Round her neck a leather cord with a small bronze pendant engraved with her name, cast from leftovers of her family's bell foundry. Her copper hair cut at the ears. She stands relaxed, one hand on the pendant.
private: At the corps' quarters in the evening: the robe off, a loose long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the shins, wool stockings and soft slippers, the pendant on its cord. She sits on her bunk carving a name into a small wooden slip with the knife, a happy, chatty look.
battle: In the casting ring: the grey-blue robe belted and its sleeves tight, leather forearm guards, the bronze pendant outside the robe. In her right hand a short slim casting rod held up in front of her, a hand-bell in the left; a concentrated look, the lips moving in a chant.
formal: For a muster of the corps: her best clean grey-blue robe pressed flat, the three rings embroidered in silver thread, a white collar, a short dark cloak over one shoulder, hair neatly tucked behind the ears, the pendant outside. She stands straight, chin lifted, a proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the verdigris eyes looking straight at the viewer with a bright, talkative look, the mouth caught mid-sentence in a quick smile. Warm bronze lamp light from one side. She holds the engraved bronze pendant between two fingers near her chin. Foreground blur: out-of-focus bell ropes and drifting bronze dust.

name: 兰薇格·炉脉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:839
who: Lanvig of the Hearthvein line, a dwarf woman and stoker-chief in the belly chamber of the first sky-tall war construct, a hundred and ninety years old and looking about sixty: about 128 cm, short, stocky and thick-set, a thick back and shoulders and short, broad arms. Snow-white hair in one thick braid wound once around her neck like a scarf, the end fastened with a black bead ground from furnace slag. Orange-red eyes like banked coals, with a network of fine lines at the corners from watching fire. Palms polished bright from a hundred and seventy years of pressing furnace grates. A calm, dry, quietly commanding air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face of about sixty, a dwarf woman, NOT a child: orange-red almond eyes like banked coals, a network of fine lines at their corners, level white brows, a broad nose, a firm closed mouth, a strong jaw; ruddy cheeks warmed by furnace light.
build: 128 cm, a short, stocky dwarf woman: thick back and shoulders, short strong arms, a C-cup, a thick waist and sturdy rounded hips.
palette: snow white and furnace orange, soot black, dark leather, brass, mica amber
casual: The Hearthvein line's thick leather apron with the family's hearth-vein mark stitched on the shoulder, over a coarse wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and dark wool trousers, heavy boots. At the belt a palm-sized brass lamp with a mica shade, a small flame inside that has not gone out in a hundred and seventy years; on the other side a long-handled fire tong with its jaws worn bright. A pair of smoked goggles pushed up on her forehead. The white braid wound round her neck. She stands square and solid, arms folded.
private: In the lull of the belly chamber after a shift: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved coarse wool shirt-dress to the shins in warm brown, thick socks and slippers, the white braid unwound over one shoulder. She sits on a stool beside the brass lamp holding a mug of hot broth in both hands, a calm, weary look.
battle: Defending the furnace chamber: the heavy leather apron with the hearth-vein mark belted over a chain-mail vest, thick leather gauntlets and forearm guards bound with copper wire, the goggles down, a small flame lamp at her belt. In her right hand the long fire tong held like a short spear across her body, her left hand raised flat to hold off the heat; planted low and wide, a stern look.
battle_pose: 3) the stoker-chief's outfit at the furnace: standing square in front of a roaring furnace door with the fire tong gripped in both hands and the smoked goggles pulled down over her eyes, the white braid swinging, the furnace glow lighting her face from below, a stern, focused look.
formal: For the first firing of a new furnace: a clean thick leather apron with the hearth-vein mark embroidered in orange thread over a charcoal wool shirt with rolled sleeves and sturdy trousers, a mail collar, a copper-wire cuff on each wrist, the white braid decorated with the black slag bead, the brass mica lamp hung at her belt with a small flame that never goes out, polished boots. She stands very straight with her hands folded, a solemn, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned a little, the orange-red eyes looking steadily at the viewer, a calm, weathered, grown woman's face with fine lines. Warm furnace light from below on one side. She cups the small brass lamp in one polished palm near her chest. Foreground blur: out-of-focus drifting sparks and soot.

name: 芬珂·七灯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:988
who: Finke Sevenlamps, a human ship captain of the great chain-ship Long Chain from a chain-barge family, fifty-eight: about 172 cm, tall, broad in the shoulder and straight-backed, standing with her knees always soft as if nailed to a pitching deck. Greying short hair cut at the ears, pinned on the left with a brass clip. Cheeks permanently reddened by salt wind. Sea-green eyes like shallow salt water that look first at what a person holds. A thumb-sized bronze bell on her right earlobe (on the viewer's left when they face us), taken from her family's seven-lamp chain. A steady, dry, unhurried air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered woman's face of about fifty-eight: sea-green almond eyes with fine crow's-feet, short level grey-brown brows, windburnt red cheeks, a straight nose, a firm mouth; short grey hair pinned with a brass clip.
build: 172 cm, tall and broad in the shoulder: an upright, solid frame, a C-cup, a sturdy waist and strong legs.
palette: salt grey and white, sea green, oilskin navy, brass, windburn red
casual: A chain-barge family's oilcloth short jacket over a fleet-blue shirt, closing with buttons, two brass buttons missing and replaced by small iron rings from the chain; dark trousers and thick-soled soft boots polished by the deck. At the belt a palm-sized slate with a stick of white chalk for reckoning the bearing home; a register book from the engineers' office clamped under one arm. The bronze bell on her right ear. She stands with her feet apart and arms crossed.
private: In the captain's cabin off watch: the oilcloth jacket off, a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt and knitted waistcoat, dark trousers and slippers, the brass clip out and the grey hair loose to her ears. She leans over the slate chart with a cup of tea, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Commanding on the chain-ship bridge: the oilcloth jacket buttoned to the throat over the fleet-blue shirt, a leather harness belt, the slate hung at her side, the register tucked away. Her right hand grips the long push-bar like a staff and her left points ahead; planted wide and low, a hard, commanding look.
battle_pose: 3) the captain's outfit at the bar: legs set wide, both hands gripping a long steering bar and leaning her whole weight into it, the grey hair and the bronze ear bell swinging, a hard, focused look.
formal: For a ship's muster: a deep navy fleet coat with every button in place, a white shirt with a plain neckcloth, a captain's brass pin at the collar, polished boots, the bronze bell on her ear and the brass clip in her hair. She stands very upright with hands behind her back, a dignified, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the sea-green eyes looking straight at the viewer with a dry, steady look, a faint closed smile. Cool white light from one side, as of a salt-sea window. She holds the small bronze ear bell between two fingers. Foreground blur: out-of-focus iron chain links and drifting sea spray.

name: 索兰
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1044
who: Solan, a dragonkin helmsman in the left knee cabin of the chain-ship Long Chain, two hundred and fourteen years old but a slow-ageing dragonkin looking about forty: about 194 cm, tall with a big frame and broad shoulders, tall even seated. Mixed verdigris and grey scales, densest on the sides of the neck and the backs of the hands; on the left calf a cracked scale (on the viewer's right when they face us) with a lighter new scale growing in the crack. Short rust-red hair. Orange-gold slit-pupilled eyes that do not blink. Always barefoot, the soles scaled and worn like old boot leather. A calm, listening, unhurried air.
build: 194 cm, tall and heavy-framed: very broad shoulders and back, thick arms, long strong legs.
palette: verdigris and grey scales, rust red, orange gold, old leather brown, brass
casual: A helm crew's old leather armour, the knees patched three times and the left knee guard newly replaced, over a plain grey shirt and dark trousers rolled to the shin; he wears no shoes, a pair of boots tied together hanging at his belt to be put on when he leaves the ship. Round his neck a brass tag stamped with the seat number of his knee cabin. Scales on his neck and hands. He stands relaxed with his eyes closed, his bare feet flat on the floor as if listening to the ground.
private: In the helm cabin off watch: the leather armour off, a loose long-sleeved grey shirt and dark trousers rolled to the shin, bare feet flat on a copper plate, the brass tag in his hand. He sits with his eyes closed, a calm, drowsy look.
battle: At the helm under attack: the patched leather armour buckled, the new knee guard bright, leather forearm guards, bare feet planted on the copper plate. He grips two push-bars at once in his large hands, the muscles of his neck standing out, the slit eyes wide and unblinking; a hard, focused look.
formal: For a ship's muster: a clean dark grey helm crew leather vest with the knee patches renewed, a white shirt with sleeves rolled, the brass seat tag polished and hung on the outside, a fleet-blue sash, the boots put on for once, the rust hair neatly combed, a pair of small verdigris scale plates on the shoulders that shine faintly. He stands tall with his hands behind his back, a grave, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned a little, the orange-gold slit-pupilled eyes unblinking and looking straight at the viewer, a quiet, steady look. Warm lamp light from one side catches the verdigris scales on his neck. He holds the brass seat tag against his chest. Foreground blur: out-of-focus copper plates and drifting steam.

name: 达里奥·晨唤
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1100
who: Dario Dawncall, a tiefling winder at the winding yard of the chain-ship Long Chain, a hundred and twelve years old and looking about fifty-five: about 183 cm, tall and thin, the back slightly bent from a lifetime of leaning over key slots. A pair of short horns lying back along the skull, the left horn tip chipped (on the viewer's right when they face us). A thin tail hanging to the ankle with a small brass tuning whistle tied at its tip. Pale grey marks like bone carving on cheeks and neck, from his grandmother's line. Silver-white hair tied at the back of the head. Very pale violet eyes that examine machines more carefully than people. A quiet, precise, patient air. Horn check, repeated: his horns are a matched PAIR, one rising from each temple just above the hairline, short (about a hand-span long), dark and smooth, both lying flat back along the skull over the hair like a goat's horns that sweep back close to the head, the same length and shape on both sides in every panel; only the tip of the left horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is chipped off blunt. NOT one single long horn arching over the top of the head. Horn symmetry, repeated once more: the two horns are mirror images of each other, exactly the same length, thickness and curve, one above each temple, and BOTH tips are fully visible in every panel even when the head is turned; neither horn is bigger, longer or higher than the other, and neither is hidden in the hair. Each horn is only about a hand-span long and lies back close to the skull like a goat's horn, not rising upward. The tip of the left horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) ends in a flat chipped stump instead of a point.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean tiefling man's face of about fifty-five: very pale violet eyes with fine lines at the corners, silver-white level brows, a long straight nose, a calm closed mouth; faint pale grey bone-like marks on cheeks and neck.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin, slightly stooped, with long fingers and wiry arms.
palette: silver white, pale violet, charcoal, brass, old leather brown, bone grey
casual: A winding yard's old leather apron with a row of small pockets on the chest holding a spanner and several brass tuning picks, over a plain grey shirt with the cuffs wrapped in copper wire so a winch cannot catch them, dark trousers and boots. At his belt a thick leather-bound book worn smooth, holding the name, tuning and namer of every automaton he has wound. The silver hair tied back, the whistle on his tail tip. He stands with his head slightly tilted, as if listening.
private: In the winding yard office after the day: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt and waistcoat, dark trousers and slippers, the copper wire unwound from his cuffs. He sits turning a brass tuning pick in his fingers with the thick book open on his knee, a mild, thoughtful look.
battle: Standing over a winder at an alarm: the leather apron belted tight with all its pockets buckled, leather gloves, forearm guards, the thick book strapped against his chest. In his right hand a long brass winding key held out in front of him, the left hand raised flat as if to hold a machine still; standing braced and leaning forward, a sharply focused look, no machine drawn.
battle_pose: 3) the winder's outfit ready at an alarm: standing braced with the feet apart and the body leaning forward, both hands gripping a long brass winding key held out at chest height as if about to turn it, no machine or key slot drawn, the tail whistle swinging and the tail curled tight, the pale violet eyes fixed, a tense, concentrated look.
formal: For a naming ceremony of a new automaton: the winder's clean leather apron with its row of small pockets, a charcoal wool shirt under it with the cuffs wrapped in neat copper wire, the leather-bound book carried against his chest, the brass tuning pick pinned at the collar, the silver hair neatly tied, the tail whistle polished, a small clockwork key on a chain that turns slowly by itself. He stands straight with his head slightly bowed, a grave, gentle look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the very pale violet eyes looking at the viewer with a careful, measuring look, the mouth closed. Warm brass lamp light from one side; the tail with its small brass whistle curls into the frame near his shoulder. Foreground blur: out-of-focus brass gears and drifting oil-lamp glow.

name: 赫塔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1252
who: Herta, a demon-kin water carrier of the Bone-white line of the western wastes, thirty-one: about 167 cm, medium height, sturdy, with long arms from a lifetime of leading pack animals. Ash-grey skin; along the outer side of the left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us) a length of white bone shows from elbow to wrist, set into the skin like a strip of white jade, born that way. Frost-white hair cut at the chin that blows backward in the wind. Pale amber eyes with a cold white glint in the pupils at night. A small bone tag engraved with her number pierced through each earlobe. A steady, plain, dependable air. Skin colour check, repeated: her skin is a clear ASH-GREY over the whole body, face, neck, hands and forearm alike, a medium grey with a faint cool blue undertone, plainly grey and not pale pink, peach or cream in any panel; the white bone strip on her forearm reads lighter than the grey skin around it.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's face of about thirty, ash-grey skin with cool grey shadows, pale amber almond eyes, level white brows, a straight nose, a closed, plain mouth.
build: 167 cm, sturdy and long-armed: strong shoulders, a B-cup, a firm waist and sturdy legs.
palette: ash grey and bone white, frost white hair, pale amber, felt grey, leather brown
casual: A water carrier's thick felt cloak in grey, the hem sewn with a ring of bone buttons that can be fastened up when the wind is strong, over a plain grey tunic belted at the waist, dark trousers and boots. At her belt a bone whistle for calling her pack beasts. Her hands wrapped in worn rein-cloth, the one on her left done up by her sister. A water skin the size of a man across her back on a strap. The bone strip bare on her forearm. She stands steady with a rein in one hand.
private: At the camp's edge after the last well-run: the cloak off, a loose long-sleeved grey wool tunic-dress to the shins, thick stockings and house shoes, the rein-cloth unwound, the frost hair tucked behind her ears. She sits on a water barrel with a bowl of broth, a quiet, tired look.
battle: On the road under threat: the felt cloak buttoned up with its bone buttons, leather forearm guards, the bone whistle at her lips. In her right hand a pack beast's lead rein and in her left a short cleaver held low; planted wide on the sand, a stern, watchful look.
formal: For a camp's gathering at the well: a long clean ash-grey wool gown with long sleeves, a narrow band of bone-button trim at the collar, the felt cloak fastened over it, the frost hair neatly tucked, the ear tags polished. She stands upright with her hands folded, a composed, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale amber eyes looking straight at the viewer with a plain, steady look, the mouth closed. Cold blue night light from one side, a faint warm lantern glow below. The bare strip of white bone on her forearm is held up near her chin. Foreground blur: out-of-focus drifting ash and the muzzle of a pack beast.

name: 罗埃尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1308
who: Loel, a winged demon-kin courier of the Night-wing line, twenty-six: about 178 cm, tall, lean, narrow-shouldered and light-boned, standing as if about to leap. A pair of grey-brown wings on his back, white-tipped, folded down to the backs of the knees, the feathers densest at the wing roots where nobody may touch. Tousled sand-gold hair that the wind never lets lie flat. Amber eyes, the pupils wide at night. On the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) a bone tag worn as an earring, carved with his name. A quick, restless, friendly air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young man's face of twenty-six: amber almond eyes with wide pupils, sand-gold brows, a straight nose, a quick open smile; light skin.
build: 178 cm, tall, lean, narrow-shouldered and light-boned, with long wiry arms and legs.
palette: grey-brown feathers with white tips, sand gold, amber, leather brown, bone
casual: A courier's short leather jacket with two slits cut in the back for the wings, the slit edges sewn with soft leather, over a plain shirt, dark trousers and soft boots. At the belt an oilskin letter pouch with its flap closed by a bone toggle. On his right wrist (on the viewer's left when they face us) a stack of a dozen small bone rings, one for each camp, each carved with that camp's number. The grey-brown wings folded neatly. He stands light on his feet, ready to jump.
private: In a camp's guest tent: the jacket off, a loose long-sleeved linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and the wings stretched out to rest, dark trousers and bare feet, the pouch on a peg. He shares a flat loaf with a child, a relaxed, cheerful look.
battle: Flying a message through danger: the leather jacket buckled, leather bracers, the letter pouch strapped tight across the chest. In his right hand a short dagger held low, the grey-brown wings half open and tilted behind him; crouched at the lip of a pit ready to launch, a keen, alert look.
battle_pose: 3) the courier's outfit in flight: swooping low through a gust with the wings spread wide and tilted, one arm clutching the pouch to his chest and the other stretched forward for balance, the feathers streaming, a daring, exhilarated look.
formal: For delivering a camp's seal to a high seat: a clean dark grey wool coat with slits at the back for the wings, closing down the front with buttons, a white shirt collar, the bone rings polished on his wrist, the bone tag in his ear, the wings neatly folded. He stands straight, chin up, with the pouch held before him in both hands, a proud, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the amber eyes with wide pupils looking straight at the viewer with a bright, quick look, a small open smile. Cold blue dusk light from one side, a warm lantern glow below. The white-tipped grey-brown wing tip curves into the frame beside his shoulder. Foreground blur: out-of-focus drifting feathers and small bone rings.

name: 皮雅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1460
who: Pia, a beast-eared scout of the Bell-tail clan guarding a fire at the southernmost gate-tunnel of the wall, eighteen but small and slight, looking about sixteen or seventeen. About 151 cm, small and light, fully covered by her clothes. A pair of round, large ears with white tips; a short bushy tail with a tiny brass bell tied at the tip, the bell's clapper wrapped in cloth so it does not ring while she keeps the fire. Fluffy pale-gold hair cut at the ears, as the clan's rule for messenger children. Gold-green eyes with large pupils at night that catch firelight like two fireflies. A bright, earnest, stubborn air. Ear check, repeated: her ears are a matched pair of large ROUNDED ears standing upright on top of the head, like a round-eared cat's, with white fur at the rounded tips, the same upright rounded shape in every panel; they never hang down or droop.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young girl's face of about sixteen: large gold-green almond eyes with large pupils, soft pale-gold brows, a small nose, round cheeks with a warm flush, a firm closed mouth.
palette: pale gold, gold-green, grey wool, brass, soft brown
casual: A scout's grey short tunic with the sleeves and trouser legs bound tight, an old scouts' blanket wrapped around her as a cloak, soft short boots with thin copper soles. At the belt a flat leather pouch holding a pen, ink and a roll of practice maps given to her by Lowry. Inside her coat a cloth bundle holding half a loaf left by Timu. The brass bell on her bushy tail with its clapper wrapped in cloth. She sits cross-legged by a fire, wide-eyed and earnest.
private: Beside the gate-tunnel fire at rest: the blanket round her shoulders over a soft long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the shins, thick stockings and house shoes, the ears relaxed. She holds a small map and a pen, a quiet, sleepy look.
battle: Out on a scouting run into the dead land: the grey short tunic bound snug with copper-wire cuffs, a short leather jerkin, leather forearm guards, a small ring badge on the shoulder, the blanket tied on her back like a pack. In her right hand a short knife held low and her left hand a small signal torch; crouched low, ears forward, wide-eyed and serious.
formal: For a roll-call at the gate: a clean grey scout's short tunic with sleeves and trouser legs bound snug with new cord, a dark blue sash, a small sewn ring badge on the shoulder, a folded scouts' blanket over one arm, the brass bell polished, soft boots with thin copper soles, hair neatly combed behind the ears. She stands straight with her hands at her sides, a proud, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold-green eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with an earnest look, the mouth closed. Warm orange firelight from one side lights her cheek and the white-tipped ears. She holds a rolled map in both hands near her chin. Foreground blur: out-of-focus embers and drifting sparks.
art_extra: Her hair stays the same pale gold as in the sheet under the firelight, only the shadow side a little darker.

name: 阿芙
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1516
who: Afu, a beast-eared scout of the Bell-tail clan, the lead bell of the scouts' line at the southernmost wall, twenty-four: about 165 cm, tall and lean, long-legged with hard runner's muscle in the calves. A pair of long pointed ears, black on the backs, laid flat when she runs; a long thin tail with a brass bell tied at its tip, rubbed bright. Short fiery red hair cut at the ears. A faint scar across her forehead (above the viewer's right eyebrow when they face us) from her first line-crossing fall at seventeen. Orange-gold eyes that narrow to slits when she laughs and never blink when she looks south. A cocky, quick, bright air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young woman's face of twenty-four: orange-gold almond eyes, short fiery red brows, a faint pale scar across the forehead, a wide quick grin; light skin with a few freckles.
build: 165 cm, tall and lean: long legs with hard runner's muscle, a C-cup, a narrow waist.
palette: fiery red, orange gold, scout grey, brass, black ear backs, copper
casual: A scout's grey short tunic with sleeves and trouser legs bound tight, soft short boots made by her family's own hands with a thin copper sheet on the soles so they do not slip on the dead land's ash. At the belt a short knife in its sheath. Her tail bell never has its clapper wrapped; it rings with every step. The ears upright and alert. She stands on the balls of her feet, ready to dash south.
private: At the scouts' bunkhouse: the tunic off, a loose long-sleeved grey wool tunic-dress to the shins, thick stockings, the red hair ruffled, the ears relaxed. She lies back on her bunk with her feet up on the wall, laughing, a carefree, happy look.
battle: Running the lead line into the dead land: the grey tunic bound snug with copper-wire cuffs, a short leather jerkin and bracers, the copper-soled boots, a thin dark cloak streaming behind with a ring badge sewn at the shoulder. In her right hand the short knife drawn and held back, the brass bell on her tail ringing; mid-leap, ears flat, a fierce, daring look.
formal: For a scouts' roll-call: a clean grey scout's short tunic with sleeves and trouser legs bound snug, a dark blue sash, a folded blanket cloak over one shoulder, a copper thread sewn along the cuffs, copper-soled boots polished, the brass bell polished and ringing once on its own, the red hair combed neat. She stands with her chin lifted and hands behind her back, a bright, confident look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the orange-gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with a cocky, bright look, a wide grin. Warm late-sun light from one side; the brass bell on her tail curls into the frame beside her shoulder. Foreground blur: out-of-focus drifting ash and a streak of red cloth.

name: 提穆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1572
who: Timu, a beast-eared scout and cook of the Bell-tail clan at the southernmost wall, twenty-seven: about 189 cm, tall and large, with wide shoulders and a thick back, thick through the waist and legs. A pair of floppy large ears that droop down, a thick bushy tail that sweeps slowly as he walks. Messy cream-coloured hair always dusted with flour. A round face with honey-coloured eyes that look at people as if wondering whether they are hungry. Both hands covered in burn scars. A big, gentle, unhurried air.
build: 189 cm, large and thick-set: wide shoulders and thick back, a broad waist and strong legs, a soft round belly.
palette: cream and honey, flour white, scout grey, soot black, copper
casual: A scout's grey short tunic with the sleeves and trouser legs bound tight, an apron stained that no washing will whiten tied on over it, only removed when he goes out. At his belt a copper pot with a soot-black bottom holding salt and flint. On his back a pack bigger than the others' by a full size, in which he carries the whole unit's spare rations. Soft short boots. His ears droop and his bushy tail sweeps slowly. He stands calm and broad, one hand on the strap.
private: At the unit's hearth-room: the apron on and the tunic's sleeves rolled up, floury hands kneading a lump of dark bread dough on a table, the pot beside him. He hums with his ears loose, a happy, content look.
battle: Stepping up to defend the hearth-room: the grey tunic bound tight, a thick leather apron over it and leather forearm guards, the copper pot raised in one hand like a shield. In the other hand a heavy iron ladle held back like a club; planted wide with the ears flat, a protective, grim look.
battle_pose: 3) the cook-scout's outfit defending the hearth: a wide braced stance with the copper pot raised in front like a shield and a heavy iron ladle swung back in the other hand, the ears flattened and the tail bristled, a protective, determined look.
formal: For a unit's mid-winter feast: a clean grey scout's short tunic with sleeves bound at the cuffs under a clean white apron embroidered at its hem with small wheat sheaves, a blanket cloak folded on one shoulder, flour brushed from the hair, the copper pot polished and held in both hands like a platter, a rune cut into its base that keeps the food warm. He stands tall with his ears upright, a warm, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey eyes looking straight at the viewer with a gentle, warm look, a soft closed smile. Warm hearth light from one side. He holds a loaf of dark bread in both burn-scarred hands near his chest. Foreground blur: out-of-focus steam and drifting flour.

name: 格里姆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:1628
who: Grim, a dwarf master mechanic of the foundry under the lookout at the southernmost wall, seventy-four: a dwarf's prime, looking about forty. About 136 cm, short and wide, shoulders thick, arms as thick as posts. A great iron-black beard braided in three strands, each end fitted with a small brass whistle. The left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) wrapped round with a strip of soft leather, worn while working on machines and taken off at night to listen. Brass-coloured eyes that narrow when he looks at a machine and close when he listens south. A gruff, patient, careful air.
build: 136 cm, a short, wide dwarf man: thick shoulders, arms like posts, a broad barrel chest, sturdy legs.
palette: iron black, brass, forge orange, leather brown, soot grey
casual: The Cliff line's thick leather apron with a row of chisels along the front, over a coarse grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and dark trousers, heavy boots. At his belt a roster book with brass-bound corners, its pages curled from turning. Hanging from his neck a tiny brass whistle, the first machine's, whose whistle he has never heard again. The three-braided iron-black beard with brass whistles at the ends, the left ear wrapped in soft leather. He stands square, arms crossed.
private: In the foundry office after the day: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved coarse wool shirt and waistcoat, slippers, the leather strip off his ear. He sits with his eyes closed listening toward the south, the little brass whistle in his hand, a calm, tired look.
battle: Defending the foundry: the heavy leather apron with the chisel row belted tight, thick leather gauntlets with copper wire at the cuffs, a smoked-glass goggle pulled down over his eyes, a brass whistle badge on the chest. In both hands a long-handled iron hammer held across his body, rune lines on its head glowing dull red, the beard swinging; planted wide and low, a stern, focused look.
battle_pose: 3) the master mechanic's outfit at the foundry floor: a wide braced stance in front of an automaton's open chest, a long-handled hammer swung back in both hands, the three beard-braids swinging and the whistles flashing, a stern, focused look.
formal: For the naming of a new machine: a clean leather foundry apron with the chisel row over a charcoal wool shirt with rolled sleeves, copper wire wound round both cuffs, a brass whistle badge on the chest, the beard braids freshly oiled with the brass whistles polished, the roster book held against his chest, a thumb-sized spring-wound brass cog on his belt that ticks softly. He stands very straight, a solemn, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face turned slightly, the brass-coloured eyes closed or narrowed as if listening, a solemn, gruff look with the mouth closed in the beard. Warm forge light from one side. He holds the little brass whistle close to his ear. Foreground blur: out-of-focus drifting sparks and brass gears.
